                  WELCOME TO PLASTIC LABS
                  
                

Here you&#039;ll find our blog, research, and public notes. You can also engage with the ideas directly.
Plastic is an engineering-driven AI lab building at the intersection of machine learning and cognitive science.
Our focus is developing Honcho, an AI-native memory solution powered by our state-of-the-art reasoning models. Honcho is a continual learning system for modeling personal identity, and soon a shared context layer for individual alignment.
The foundational layer of intelligence being built is just the beginning. Latent among the scores of specialized secondary and tertiary layers yet to be realized exists one for personal identity.
We&#039;re building it.


Guide
We post a few different types of content here:

Posts - Deep dives into the cogsci, development, &amp; ML underpinning our projects
Research - Preprint or blog-style research we&#039;ve made public
Notes - Short-form working notes on Plastic theses
Archive - Legacy content about out-of-date or depreciated projects &amp; features
Careers - Open positions at Plastic

Subscribe to updates.
